title: Reference-runtime architecture
preamble:
# Reference-runtime architecture

The shape of the DS
reference runtime: tier mechanism (topology-agnostic),
engine subsystems (working memory, Rete, agenda,
conflict resolver, recorder, dispatcher, clock source,
consumption loop), cross-tier fact flow, threading,
clock model, determinism invariants, and the
compilation model. The language-side tier contract
lives in [LTIE];
this doc specifies the mechanism that realises it.

## What this is not

- Not a language-semantic spec — see the language tree.
- Not the DS → native-Rete lowering spec — see [RLOW].
- Not a transport spec. The reference runtime commits to the semantics of
  one engine. It reaches anything outside its process only through callbacks
  the integrator registers, and moving facts between tiers is the
  integrator's.
- Not a deployment / operations guide.
